quote: My land dispute has been in court since before I was born. I'm 45 now. The judge who started the case has retired, joined politics, and is probably governing a state somewhere.
author: Rajesh K., Delhi

quote: Filed an RTI about a judge's assets. Got a contempt notice instead. The system protects its own.
author: Anonymous, Mumbai

quote: My father died waiting for his case to be heard. I inherited the case along with the house. The house is gone now — sold to pay lawyer fees. The case continues.
author: Meera S., Patna

quote: The judge who denied my bail was the chief guest at the complainant's son's wedding. I found out after spending 8 months in jail.
author: Vikram T., Lucknow

quote: Three adjournments because the judge was 'on leave.' Fourth hearing — the judge got transferred. Fifth hearing — new judge wanted to start from scratch. It's been 7 years for a cheque bounce case.
author: Priya D., Bengaluru

quote: I was told my case is 'next' for 11 consecutive hearings. I've started bringing lunch.
author: Sunil M., Jaipur

quote: Watched a corporate giant get 6 adjournments in a pollution case. When a farmer asked for one, he was told the court doesn't have time. Justice is blind, but it recognizes money.
author: Anita R., Bhopal

quote: The sealed cover in my case apparently contained evidence I couldn't see. I was convicted based on it. Still don't know what was in it.
author: Name Withheld, Chennai
